current_objective: Build browser-local library persistence, deterministic MIDI mapping/learn, post-mixer recording and AudioParam-timeline automation without changing realtime transport or SYNC authority.
known_limitations: Web MIDI is permissioned and not universally available; hardware-controller proof is environment-dependent.
Library v1 stores encoded audio in browser IndexedDB and is not yet the distributed library provider.
Recording format depends on MediaRecorder codecs supported by the current browser.
Automation v1 covers continuous AudioParams; cue/hotcue/seek command automation is not included.
exact_next_action: Run Phase 10 unit/build/browser gates including IndexedDB persistence, MIDI routing, master recording, AudioParam automation under UI stall and all locked Phase 2-9 regressions.
